description: User-facing Style Settings surface (mgmeyers/obsidian-style-settings) for the HearthCode Obsidian app theme. Only safe tuning knobs are exposed here; the calibrated semantic palette stays generated-only and is never user-editable, so the color contracts cannot be broken from the settings UI. Rendered into obsidian/app-theme/theme.css by scripts/generate-obsidian-app-theme.mjs.
name: HearthCode

settings.title: Monospace note font
settings.description: Render notes in your configured monospace font for a typewriter-style editing feel.

settings.title: Disable comment italics
settings.description: Render code-comment italics upright. Mirrors the VS Code hearthcode.disableItalics option and helps CJK fonts that fake-oblique instead of slanting.

settings.title: Readable line length
settings.description: Column width for readable line length, in rem. Applies when the Readable line length setting is enabled.

settings.title: Callout background
settings.description: How strongly callout backgrounds are tinted. Quiet is subtle; bold is more saturated. Medium is the theme default.

settings.title: Accent color
settings.description: Swap the accent (links, active controls, buttons) for a contrast-vetted preset. Moss is the default sage; Amber is warm; Slate is cool. Every preset keeps button and link text at AA 4.5:1.
